script:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {

    prompt.HoldDuration = 0

bypassButton.Parent = mainFrame

moveButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 0.13, 0)
moveButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.27, 0)
moveButton.Text = "Move to Stand"
moveButton.TextScaled = true

moveButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
moveButton.Parent = mainFrame

local moveCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
moveCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.2, 0)
moveCorner.Parent = moveButton

local stopButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
stopButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.24, 0, 0.13, 0)
stopButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.27, 0)
stopButton.Text = "STOP"
stopButton.TextScaled = true

local respawnButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
respawnButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.13, 0)
respawnButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.42, 0)
respawnButton.Text = "Respawn Character"
respawnButton.TextScaled = true
respawnButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 140, 30)
respawnButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
respawnButton.Parent = mainFrame

local respawnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
respawnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.2, 0)
respawnCorner.Parent = respawnButton

local tpWalkButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
tpWalkButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.13, 0)
tpWalkButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.57, 0)
tpWalkButton.Text = "TP Walk: OFF"
tpWalkButton.TextScaled = true
tpWalkButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
tpWalkButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
tpWalkButton.Parent = mainFrame

local tpWalkCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

tpWalkCorner.Parent = tpWalkButton

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

speedLabel.TextScaled = true

local speedBar = Instance.new("Frame")
speedBar.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.07, 0)
speedBar.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.83, 0)

speedBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
speedBar.Parent = mainFrame

local speedBarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
speedBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
speedBarCorner.Parent = speedBar

local speedHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
speedHandle.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 2, 0)
speedHandle.Position = UDim2.new(0.16, 0, -0.5, 0)
speedHandle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
speedHandle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
speedHandle.Text = ""
speedHandle.Parent = speedBar

local speedHandleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
speedHandleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
speedHandleCorner.Parent = speedHandle

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPosition

    local function updatePosition(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = guiObject.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        -- The payload checks MouseButton1 here rather than MouseMovement.
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)
end

makeDraggable(mainFrame)
makeDraggable(toggleUiButton)

bypassButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = localPlayer.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    local oldHumanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if oldHumanoid then
        oldHumanoid:Destroy()
    end

    local replacementHumanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    replacementHumanoid.Parent = character
end)

local activeTween

moveButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if activeTween then
        activeTween:Cancel()
    end

    local character = localPlayer.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        return
    end

    local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(
        544.577637,
        92.0762939,
        -364.869049,
        -1, 0, 0,
        0, 1, 0,
        0, 0, -1
    )

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
        7,
        Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
        Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
        0,
        false,
        0
    )

    activeTween = TweenService:Create(rootPart, tweenInfo, {
        CFrame = targetCFrame,
    })

    stopButton.Visible = true

    activeTween.Completed:Connect(function()
        stopButton.Visible = false
        activeTween = nil
    end)

    activeTween:Play()
end)

stopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if activeTween then
        activeTween:Cancel()
        activeTween = nil
    end

    stopButton.Visible = false
end)

respawnButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = localPlayer.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Health = 0
    end
end)

local tpWalkEnabled = false
local tpSpeed = 50

tpWalkButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    tpWalkEnabled = not tpWalkEnabled

    if tpWalkEnabled then
        tpWalkButton.Text = "TP Walk: ON"
        tpWalkButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 139, 87)
    else
        tpWalkButton.Text = "TP Walk: OFF"
        tpWalkButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    end
end)

local function updateSpeed(input)
    local relativePosition = math.clamp(
        (input.Position.X - speedBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / speedBar.AbsoluteSize.X,
        0,
        1
    )

    tpSpeed = math.floor(1 + relativePosition * 299)
    speedHandle.Position = UDim2.new(relativePosition, 0, -0.5, 0)
    speedLabel.Text = "TP Speed: " .. tpSpeed .. " Studs/s"
end

local draggingSpeed = false

speedHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
        draggingSpeed = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
        draggingSpeed = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if draggingSpeed
        and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
    then
        updateSpeed(input)
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not tpWalkEnabled then
        return
    end

    local character = localPlayer.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
        rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + humanoid.MoveDirection * tpSpeed * deltaTime
    end
end)
